title: Through the Lens of Split Vote: Exploring Disagreement, Difficulty and Calibration in Legal Case Outcome Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating the democratic index and political reputation of the defending state ('HighRepCountry' proxy) with the entropy of judges' vote distributions to determine if specific state contexts lead to higher judicial disagreement.
Evaluating the correlation between the applicant's vulnerable status ('VulnApplicant' proxy) and the entropy of the judges' vote distributions using independent t-tests.

Analyzing human label variation (split votes) among judges from 46 diverse member states to capture subjective disagreements driven by differing cultural backgrounds and pluralistic human values, and evaluating how well model confidence calibrates to this human uncertainty.
